institutional_mirror.announcement_provenance: The university announcement identifies the attachment as the formal seventh edition and states that CCF released it on 2026-03-31.
institutional_mirror.local_pdf_temporary_path: Local evidence retained privately; see source URL and checksum.
version_checks: University provenance explicitly identifies the formal seventh edition.
PDF creation and modification dates are 2026-04-09, consistent with the correction date in the official CCF release notice.
Rank headings and all 25 listed target entries visually inspected.
institutional_mirror.limitation: The CCF-hosted download endpoint remained behind an access-verification page; byte identity between that endpoint and the institutional mirror could not be checked. The source used for ranks is the CCF-authored PDF itself, not a third-party inferred ranking table.

rejected_source.reason: The file metadata is dated 2026-03-06, before formal publication, and the file contains colored draft/change annotations. It was not used as formal-edition evidence.

publication_scope.paper_level_rule: A listed parent venue rank must not be inherited by an excluded publication type. Verify the individual paper track before applying a rank.
publication_scope.workshop_precision: The official exclusion covers accompanying workshops. Do not blanket-exclude a separately listed venue merely because its proper name contains Workshop.
publication_scope.interpretation: A venue recommendation category is not an evaluation of the quality of an individual paper.

unknown_policy.None_policy: Use None only for a verified excluded publication type or a verified absence from the complete chosen directory.
unknown_policy.preprints: The project brief separately requires arXiv-only items to be None and marked Preprint.
